english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an insulting or degrading act and the humiliation it causes.

examples.english: Being yelled at in front of everyone was real humiliation.
examples.traditional: 佢當住咁多人鬧我，真係好羞辱。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 naau6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sau1 juk6
